solutions.name: tabs
solutions.use_when: Related panels share one screen and need keyboard navigation.
solutions.check: Use tabs only for peer content; preserve active state when appropriate.

solutions.name: toast
solutions.use_when: Transient action feedback should appear without blocking the task.
solutions.check: Avoid hiding critical errors only in a toast; verify announcement timing.
